dedupe_keys.name: pmgsy rural road network and core network data india esri india layers

description: These layers hold data of the Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana (PMGSY), the Government of India programme to connect unconnected rural habitations with all-weather roads. The District Rural Road Networks layer shows the District Rural Roads Plan network, with block, district, road category, road name, road owner and state for each road, and the core network identifies the roads needed to give each eligible habitation basic access. Further layers give district-level core network details (national highway, state highway, major district road and other road numbers and lengths, as of November 2021) and phase-wise cost per kilometre of new connectivity and upgrading roads from 2000 to 2022. The data come from the Ministry of Rural Development's PMGSY rural connectivity datasets and are served by Esri India. Coverage is national (rural India). The road network layer is released under the Government Open Data License India; other layers are for online use under Esri India terms and need an ArcGIS Online account. Caveats: the ministry's own open data site could not be read on 2026-09-26, and some layers forbid offline export. The data support rural road network and accessibility models, exposure of rural roads to floods and landslides, and investment appraisal of road programmes. They complement the global road inventories (GRIP) catalogued here.
